data.text: **Question:** How to design a scalable microservices architecture?
Microservices decompose applications into small, independent services. Each owns its data and communicates via APIs. Requires careful design for resilience and scalability.

Microservices are small, independent services with bounded contexts. Communicate via HTTP/gRPC/message brokers. Each has its own database. Requires service discovery, load balancing, circuit breakers.
